about: Generic as-printed values per filament type: printed test bars from makers' data sheets, typed in by hand with their source. The type's value is the median of its data sheets. Rough estimates (see uncertainty_percent), never design values. docs/as-printed/strength-model.md.

default.source: Gibson & Ashby, Cellular Solids, 2nd ed. (1997): open-cell foam law (E ~ rho^2, strength ~ 0.3 rho^1.5); used for patterns without a fitted source

gyroid.source: Stiffness: power fit to the measured points of Bean, Lopez-Anido & Vel 2022, Appl. Sci. 12:2180, doi:10.3390/app12042180 (PLA, compression). Strength: Gibson & Ashby foam law

grid.source: Power fit to Table 2 of Leon-Becerra, Gonzalez-Estrada & Quiroga 2021, ACS Omega 6:30993, doi:10.1021/acsomega.1c04295 (PLA, in-plane compression, rho 0.29-0.62)

triangles.source: Power fit to Table 2 of Leon-Becerra et al. 2021, ACS Omega 6:30993 (PLA, in-plane compression, rho 0.24-0.45)

honeycomb.source: Power fit to Table 2 of Leon-Becerra et al. 2021, ACS Omega 6:30993 (PLA, in-plane compression, rho 0.36-0.67); weakest (in-plane) direction

lightning.source: assumed: lightning infill only holds up the top skins, so the core carries nothing

poisson.source: assumed: no measurement for this type found; printed ABS and PC measure 0.29-0.39 (Cantrell et al. 2017, Rapid Prototyping Journal, doi:10.1108/RPJ-03-2016-0042)

types.note: Dry values. Moist polyamide is much weaker (Polymaker: about half).
